Uma kukhishwe, umsebenzisi uyabuza ngaphambi kokuba isicelo sokugcwalisa isidingo senhlelo sithunyelwe ku-Google. Ezinye izinhlelo ngeke zikwazi ukusebenzisa i-akhawunti ye-Google uma lokhu kukhishwe.
Uma kuvunyelwe, zonke izinhlelo kuleli device zizokwazi ukubona ikheli le-email le-Google Accounts yakho ngaphandle kokugunyazwa kwangaphambili.
Uma kukhishwe, izicelo zokugunyazwa ngeke zixhumeke nokubhaliswa kwe-device, okungase kuvumele ama-device angafunwanga ukuthi anginize, kodwa kungaba nemiphumela engalindelekile.
Uma kuvunyelwe, izicelo zokugunyazwa ngeke zihlanganise igama le-device, okungase kuvumele ama-device angafunwanga ukuthi anginize, kodwa kungaba nemiphumela engalindelekile.
Uma kuvunyelwe, i-device ingathola iziboniso zokuqinisekisa zezinyathelo ezimbili ku-Google (Cloud Messaging idingeka).
Uma kuvunyelwe, i-device ingaphendula izaziso ze-Find My Device ku-Google (Cloud Messaging idingeka).
Ibhalisa i-device yakho ezinsizweni ze-Google futhi idala u-identifier we-device okungavamile. I-microG isusa ama-bits okuhlonza ngaphandle kwegama le-Google account yakho kudatha yokubhalisa.

Usengasebe usahlanganyela indawo yakho kusuka kwezinye izikhomputhi eziningi ezingena ku-Account yaka-Google efanayo noma kusuka ezinhlelweni ezingeyo zika-Google. Qiniseka ukuthi uhlola izilungiselelo zakho zokuhlanganyela indawo noma kuphi lapho kufanele kwenziwe khona.\n\nAbantu ohlanganyela nabo bazoqhubeka babona indawo yakho yokugcina ohlanganyele ngayo.

·Igama lakho nesithombe sakho

·Amandla ebhethri likesikhomputhi sakho, nokuthi liya-shaja yini
